items.coder_A: Temozolomide (established GBM therapy) is the added investigational agent in a new setting (NSCLC CNS progression); rule 6 vs rule 4 could change candidate status.
items.reason: Temozolomide is a D6 established GBM therapy tested 'in Combination With Targeted Therapy for NSCLC Patients With CNS Progression', i.e. in a new setting, which rule 6 assigns to established_therapy_experiment; osimertinib/lorlatinib are already received at entry (C3, soc_backbone). Moot for screening: the trial fails S5 (NSCLC; conditions 'Non Small Cell Lung Cancer; CNS Progression').

note: Fails S5 (NSCLC brain/CNS progression; glioblastoma only in the intervention rationale). any_molecular_selection true because the arms require EGFR exon 19/L858R or ALK fusion (matched only to backbone TKIs, so not candidate-matched).
